name: Control Plane Convergence and PGlite Migration
description: Migrate the control plane from SQLite to PGlite as the single durable authority. This is the most important new campaign — every entity, receipt, checkpoint, and memory link must converge on PGlite with transaction boundaries, constraint parity, and replay verification.
objective: Complete the SQLite-to-PGlite migration with dual-read characterization, shadow-write verification, constraint parity, and final authority cutover receipt.
